newsitem.title: UK: BCI assoc gets nod for Malaysian kiln growth.
newsitem.headline: BCI assoc gets nod for Malaysian kiln growth.

text.p: British building materials supplier Blue Circle Industries Plc said on Tuesday that its Malaysian associate has received government approval for a further kiln expansion.

It said in a statement that Associated Pan Malaysian Cement Sdn.(APMC) has permission for a kiln expansion of 2.25 million tonnes a year, to be implemented when justified by the growth of cement demand in Malaysia.
APMC, Malaysia's oldest cement producing company, is currently expanding its kiln capacity through the construction of a 1.8 million tonnes a year kiln at Kanthan.
